verdict.rationale: Weaviate's GitHub docs show it can be started locally with Docker, along with a local embedding model, which covers the lightweight local-instance path. Embedded in-process operation is attested only by a single community comment about an embedded Python package, with no first-party documentation. Missing for 10: first-party documentation of embedded/in-process mode, explicit docs positioning local mode for development and small workloads, and hands-on corroboration of embedded mode's limits.

support.subject: As a developer, I can run the database embedded in-process or as a lightweight local instance for development and small workloads

citations.quote: You can easily start Weaviate and a local vector embedding model with Docker.
Weaviate offers multiple installation and deployment options: Docker, Kubernetes, Weaviate Cloud
You can even run Weaviate as an embedded python package rather than a separate process
